title: My experience
content: So I saw the escalators, airport, etc but I was also in a large baseball stadium before rushing out. It felt like there was an invasion about to happen like with zombies. Me and many others rushed to a prison like area that had many floors. Eventually after some time there was complete panic and we moved to an area with many “pods” that if we entered in we would be safe. Anyone else have this happen? Strong feelings of being scared, panic, and distraught.
